title: Define the cyclotron-status/v1 data shape with a JSON Schema and TypeScript types
description:
One versioned snapshot an application can render without reading trace events. Fields: cyclotron {id, version, classifier}; asOf; alignment {window, labels, accuracy, precision, recall, positiveLabel, measuredOn}; calibration {saysSure, isRight, gapPoints, curve[{bin, count, accuracy}]}; reviewRate {state, rate, auditFloor, confidenceThreshold, reason, override, nextCheckAfterLabels, expectedReviewsPerWeek}; lastChange {kind promoted|dropped|definition, fromVersion, toVersion, at, summary}; pending {decisionsAwaitingReview, staleSince}. Example in project/wiki/papyrus-integration.md.

Acceptance criteria:
- A JSON Schema file and generated TypeScript types ship in the repo and the npm package.
- A Python function builds the snapshot from a DecisionFlywheel store with no model calls; specs cover an empty store, onboarding, and a store with a promoted version.
- Alignment is computed only from program-selected reviews and says so in measuredOn.
- Uses glossary words in field names and strings: decision, confidence, label, review, version.
